heading: Enhancing interactions through character design, motion solutions, paid features, and community engagement.
eyebrow: 👩‍💻 In order to get inspiration, I conduct the competitive analysis.

blocks.html: Before brainstorming innovative solutions, I conducted an in-depth analysis of AI Companion Chatbots to identify how competitors are enhancing interactions between humans and AI chatbots, and stimulating the creation process. This analysis helped me to uncover our opportunities for future growth and also better understand the users' needs.

blocks.alt: Conch Ai — Enhancing interactions through character design, motion solutions, paid features, and community engagement.

blocks.html: 👤 Characteristic figures could help reduce the user threshold and make the interaction more immersed.
✨ Multiple motion solutions for the response delay are very important.
💡 Positive guidance and feedback encourage creators to complete the creation process.
💰 Well-implemented paid features and entrance aligns the business goal of the product.
🌍 The community feature fosters more creative uses of AI characters.
